subject: general
question: What does UDAY stand for in the context of power distribution companies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY)** is a flagship scheme launched by the **Government of India** in **November 2015**.
 
• The primary aim of the scheme is to provide financial turnaround and revival of **electricity distribution companies (DISCOMs)**, which were facing severe financial and operational challenges.
 
• It was initiated under the Ministry of Power to ensure a sustainable solution to the financial distress faced by DISCOMs.
 
• The key objectives of UDAY are to achieve **operational efficiency** improvement, **reduce the cost of electricity**, and improve **financial health**.
 
• Under this scheme, state governments were allowed to take over 75% of the debt of DISCOMs and issue bonds to pay off the liabilities.
 
• The remaining 25% of the debt would be restructured by the banks, offering better repayment terms to the DISCOMs.
 
• UDAY also focuses on reducing **Aggregate Technical and Commercial (AT&C) losses**, which are a major reason for financial stress in DISCOMs.
 
• The scheme aims to improve operational efficiency through initiatives such as improving **billing efficiency**, **metering**, and reducing **power theft**.
 
• Another major focus of UDAY is to promote the use of **renewable energy** and reduce the dependency on costly power sources, hence reducing the average cost of power supply.
 
• The scheme also encourages states to take measures to improve demand-side management by promoting energy-efficient appliances and technologies such as LED bulbs and smart meters.
 
• States and DISCOMs that perform well in achieving the targets under UDAY are incentivized through additional funding and financial assistance from the central government. This motivates them to work efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Impact of UDAY:**

 
 
• The scheme has resulted in significant improvements in the financial performance of DISCOMs in several states, reducing their losses and improving their debt profiles.
 
• UDAY contributed to improving energy efficiency through widespread distribution and adoption of **energy-efficient LED bulbs**.
 
• It also helped in increasing electricity access, especially in rural areas, by ensuring the financial viability of DISCOMs.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Faced:**
 
 
• Despite its success in improving financial conditions, some states and DISCOMs have failed to meet the operational efficiency targets under UDAY.
 
• The scheme's reliance on state governments to take over debt has sometimes resulted in increased financial burden on state governments.
 
 
 
• **Other Related Initiatives:**
 
 
• **Saubhagya Yojana:** Launched in **2017**, it aims to achieve universal household electrification in India.
 
• **Deendayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY):** Focuses on rural electrification and strengthening the rural power distribution infrastructure.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Aggregate Technical and Commercial (AT&C) Losses:** These include both technical losses during power transmission and distribution and commercial losses such as theft and unmetered supply. UDAY aims to reduce these losses to **15%**.
 
• **Power Purchase Costs:** DISCOMs often face challenges due to high power purchase costs. UDAY works to rationalize these costs through transparent power purchase agreements and promoting cheaper renewable energy sources.
 
• **Debt Restructuring:** The scheme allows states to issue **UDAY bonds** at a lower interest rate to refinance the existing high-cost debt of DISCOMs, reducing their financial burden.
 
• **Performance Metrics:** UDAY monitors and evaluates the performance of states and DISCOMs based on various parameters such as operational efficiency, financial improvement, and progress in achieving renewable energy targets.
